name: Tavrimo Campus Editorial Redesign
features: REA timetable on the main screen
official rasp.rea.ru source via sync gateway
expanded and login-safe search field detection
CI validation aligned with current PWA icon and current release
backup import confirmation before replacing local data
transactional in-memory rollback when LocalStorage persistence fails
bounded Sync Gateway rate-limit and timetable caches
rate limiting based on trusted Express client IP
separate service liveness and Chromium readiness endpoints
reconnect disconnected Chromium browser on next request
reject visible-week-only timetable instead of overwriting saved full calendar
notes: Retains the 12.0.9 search-first REA sync code. CI and regression tests now target the current release and use future dates for scheduling checks. Live Render and portal sync still require deployment-level verification.
summary: Релиз надёжности: защищённый импорт резервных копий, ограничение памяти Sync Gateway, проверка IP лимита и отказ от сохранения неполного недельного расписания как полного календаря.
